scientific_integrity: Full geometric proof supplemented by independent exact polynomial calculations and finite-field absolute-irreducibility witness; finite computations do not replace the generic geometry.
scientific_limitations: Complex characteristic-zero unramified fixed-source locus only; does not classify deeper jumping, compactification boundary, or positive-characteristic behavior. Originality is provisional; comparison paper arXiv:2607.01432 was inspected only at abstract level.
title: Geometric irreducibility of the quartic normal-bundle jumping divisor on a line blow-up
